question: When the already accepted PIT cross-industry dispersion state is high, do same-session industry return ranks contain stable next-1/3/5-session direction?
why_not_a_repeat: MKT-DISP-ECON-001 established opportunity-width expansion but no direction. MKT-DISP-RANK-001/002 failed resource gates before results. This bridge uses a later accepted 241 MiB action-aware PIT panel and changes only the bounded engineering population to its registered liquid daily universe.

population.security_universe: exact accepted Cycle-015 daily eligible liquid universe

predictor.industry_score: median same-session action-aware stock step_return among t industry members

response.security_response: sum of consecutive action-aware step_return from t+1 through t+h
response.industry_response: median security response using t industry membership
response.daily_rank_ic: Spearman across supported industries between current industry score and future industry response
response.daily_top_bottom_spread: future response top current-score quintile minus bottom quintile; diagnostic only

temporal_sequence.fixed_validation: 2022-01-01 through 2023-12-31, opened only if generation passes

strategy_authorization: No strategy is defined here. A simple translation may be frozen only after both directional gates pass.
